   601→pub(crate) async fn render_spa_template(
   602→    gateway: &GatewayState,
   603→    template: SpaTemplate,
   604→) -> axum::response::Response {
   605→    let (build_ts, asset_prefix) = if is_dev_assets() {
   606→        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
   607→            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   608→            .unwrap_or_default()
   609→            .as_millis();
   610→        ("dev".to_owned(), format!("/assets/v/{ts}/"))
   611→    } else {
   612→        static HASH: std::sync::LazyLock<String> = std::sync::LazyLock::new(asset_content_hash);
   613→        (HASH.to_string(), format!("/assets/v/{}/", *HASH))
   614→    };
   615→
   616→    let nonce = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
   617→
   618→    // Resolve Shiki URL from config override or default CDN.
   619→    let shiki_url = gateway
   620→        .inner
   621→        .read()
   622→        .await
   623→        .shiki_cdn_url
   624→        .clone()
   625→        .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_SHIKI_CDN_URL.to_owned());
   626→
   627→    let body = match template {
   628→        SpaTemplate::Index => {
   629→            let gon = build_gon_data(gateway).await;
   630→            let share_meta = build_share_meta(&gon.identity);
   631→            let gon_json = script_safe_json(&gon);
   632→            let template = IndexHtmlTemplate {
   633→                build_ts: &build_ts,
   634→                asset_prefix: &asset_prefix,
   635→                nonce: &nonce,
   636→                gon_json: &gon_json,
   637→                share_title: &share_meta.title,
   638→                share_description: &share_meta.description,
   639→                share_site_name: &share_meta.site_name,
   640→                share_image_url: SHARE_IMAGE_URL,
   641→                share_image_alt: &share_meta.image_alt,
   642→                routes: &SPA_ROUTES,
   643→                shiki_url: &shiki_url,
   644→            };
   645→            match template.render() {
   646→                Ok(html) => html,
   647→                Err(e) => {
   648→                    warn!(error = %e, "failed to render index template");
   649→                    String::new()
   650→                },
   651→            }
   652→        },
   653→        SpaTemplate::Login => {
   654→            let gon = build_gon_data(gateway).await;
   655→            let gon_json = script_safe_json(&gon);
   656→            let page_title = identity_name(&gon.identity).to_owned();
   657→            let template = LoginHtmlTemplate {
   658→                build_ts: &build_ts,
   659→                asset_prefix: &asset_prefix,
   660→                nonce: &nonce,
   661→                page_title: &page_title,
   662→                gon_json: &gon_json,
   663→            };
   664→            match template.render() {
   665→                Ok(html) => html,
   666→                Err(e) => {
   667→                    warn!(error = %e, "failed to render login template");
   668→                    String::new()
   669→                },
   670→            }
   671→        },
   672→        SpaTemplate::Onboarding => {
   673→            let gon = build_gon_data(gateway).await;
   674→            let gon_json = script_safe_json(&gon);
   675→            let page_title = format!("{} onboarding", identity_name(&gon.identity));
   676→            let template = OnboardingHtmlTemplate {
   677→                build_ts: &build_ts,
   678→                asset_prefix: &asset_prefix,
   679→                nonce: &nonce,
   680→                page_title: &page_title,
   681→                gon_json: &gon_json,
   682→            };
   683→            match template.render() {
   684→                Ok(html) => html,
   685→                Err(e) => {
   686→                    warn!(error = %e, "failed to render onboarding template");
   687→                    String::new()
   688→                },
   689→            }
   690→        },
   691→        SpaTemplate::SetupRequired => {
   692→            let template = SetupRequiredHtmlTemplate {
   693→                asset_prefix: &asset_prefix,
   694→            };
   695→            match template.render() {
   696→                Ok(html) => html,
   697→                Err(e) => {
   698→                    warn!(error = %e, "failed to render setup-required template");
   699→                    String::new()
   700→                },
   701→            }
   702→        },
   703→    };
   704→
   705→    // Extract CDN origin from shiki_url for CSP script-src allowlisting.
   706→    let shiki_csp_origin = url::Url::parse(&shiki_url)
   707→        .ok()
   708→        .and_then(|u| u.host_str().map(|host| format!("{}://{host}", u.scheme())));
   709→
   710→    let csp = format!(
   711→        "default-src 'self'; \
   712→         script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'{shiki_origin}; \
   713→         style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; \
   714→         img-src 'self' data: blob:; \
   715→         media-src 'self' blob:; \
   716→         font-src 'self'; \
   717→         connect-src 'self' ws: wss:; \
   718→         frame-ancestors 'none'; \
   719→         form-action 'self'; \
   720→         base-uri 'self'; \
   721→         object-src 'none'",
   722→        shiki_origin = shiki_csp_origin
   723→            .as_deref()
   724→            .map(|o| format!(" {o}"))
   725→            .unwrap_or_default(),
   726→    );
   727→
   728→    let mut response = Html(body).into_response();
   729→    let headers = response.headers_mut();
   730→    if let Ok(val) = "no-cache, no-store".parse() {
   731→        headers.insert(axum::http::header::CACHE_CONTROL, val);
   732→    }
   733→    if let Ok(val) = csp.parse() {
   734→        headers.insert(axum::http::header::CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY, val);
   735→    }
   736→    response
   737→}

1→# Unified Identity: Technology Stack
     2→
     3→## No New Dependencies
     4→
     5→This feature is implemented entirely within the existing technology stack. No new libraries, frameworks, or services are introduced.
     6→
     7→| Layer | Technology | Version | License | Role in Feature |
     8→|-------|-----------|---------|---------|-----------------|
     9→| Database | SurrealDB | v3.0 | BSL 1.1 (existing) | Hub-spoke schema, migrations, graph traversals |
    10→| Runtime | Bun | latest (existing) | MIT | Server runtime, migration runner |
    11→| Language | TypeScript | 5.x (existing) | Apache 2.0 | Type changes, identity resolution logic |
    12→| Auth | better-auth | latest (existing) | MIT | Session/account field mapping updates |
    13→| SDK | surrealdb (JS) | v2 (existing) | Apache 2.0 | RecordId type changes, queries |
    14→| AI SDK | Vercel AI SDK | latest (existing) | Apache 2.0 | Tool context type propagation |
    15→| Embedding | OpenAI text-embedding-3-small | (existing) | Proprietary API | Identity embeddings (same pipeline) |
    16→
    17→## Technology Decisions
    18→
    19→### Why no dedicated identity service
    20→
    21→**Decision**: Identity resolution remains an in-process module, not a separate service.
    22→
    23→**Rationale**:
    24→- Team size: 1 developer + AI agents. Operational overhead of a separate service is unjustified.
    25→- Identity resolution is 1-2 SurrealDB queries. No computational complexity requiring isolation.
    26→- All callers are in the same Bun process (chat handler, MCP auth, extraction pipeline).
    27→- SurrealDB graph traversals (spoke edges) are native -- no need for caching layer.
    28→
    29→### Why SurrealDB TYPE RELATION for spoke edges (not record links)
    30→
    31→**Decision**: Use `identity_person` and `identity_agent` as TYPE RELATION tables, not embedded `record<person>` fields on identity.
    32→
    33→**Rationale**:
    34→- TYPE RELATION enables bidirectional graph traversal (`<-identity_person<-identity` from person side).
    35→- Metadata on the edge (added_at) follows existing relation patterns (owns, member_of).
    36→- SurrealDB indexes on relation `in`/`out` fields enable efficient spoke lookups.
    37→- Embedded record links would require scanning identity table to find "which identity wraps this person."
    38→
    39→### Why HNSW index on identity.embedding
    40→
    41→**Decision**: Add HNSW vector index on identity table for semantic search.
    42→
    43→**Rationale**:
    44→- Chat agent's `search_entities` tool should find identities by semantic similarity (e.g., "who manages the PM agent?").
    45→- Same 1536-dimension embedding model already used for all other entity tables.
    46→- KNN+WHERE split pattern required (per documented SurrealDB v3.0 bug) since identity will have a workspace index.
    47→
    48→### Why breaking schema change (no data migration)
    49→
    50→**Decision**: Per project convention, schema changes are breaking. No backfill scripts.
    51→
    52→**Rationale**:
    53→- AGENTS.md: "This project does NOT maintain backwards compatibility with existing data."
    54→- Identity bootstrap runs on workspace creation -- fresh data on next setup.
    55→- Eliminates migration script complexity and rollback risk.
    56→
    57→## SurrealDB Constraints and Workarounds
    58→
    59→| Constraint | Impact | Workaround |
    60→|-----------|--------|------------|
    61→| KNN + WHERE bug | Identity vector search with workspace filter returns empty | Split into LET + filter (existing pattern) |
    62→| SCHEMAFULL conditional fields | Cannot enforce "agent_type required when type=agent" on single table | Hub-spoke: agent-specific fields on separate `agent` table with its own SCHEMAFULL |
    63→| DEFINE ANALYZER outside transaction | If identity gets fulltext index, analyzer must precede BEGIN TRANSACTION | Place DEFINE ANALYZER before transaction block in migration |
    64→| No ALTER TABLE ADD FIELD | Adding identity_id to session | Use DEFINE FIELD OVERWRITE |
    65→| search::score in functions | If identity gets fulltext search | Run from app layer (existing pattern) |
    66→

    26→- All callers are in the same Bun process (chat handler, MCP auth, extraction pipeline).
    27→- SurrealDB graph traversals (spoke edges) are native -- no need for caching layer.
    28→
    29→### Why SurrealDB TYPE RELATION for spoke edges (not record links)
    30→
    31→**Decision**: Use `identity_person` and `identity_agent` as TYPE RELATION tables, not embedded `record<person>` fields on identity.
    32→
    33→**Rationale**:
    34→- TYPE RELATION enables bidirectional graph traversal (`<-identity_person<-identity` from person side).
    35→- Metadata on the edge (added_at) follows existing relation patterns (owns, member_of).
    36→- SurrealDB indexes on relation `in`/`out` fields enable efficient spoke lookups.
    37→- Embedded record links would require scanning identity table to find "which identity wraps this person."
    38→
    39→### Why no embedding/vector search on identity
    40→
    41→**Decision**: No embedding field or HNSW index on the identity table.
    42→
    43→**Rationale**:
    44→- Identity tables have low cardinality (~5-10 records per workspace: 1 owner + 3-5 template agents).
    45→- Name-based and type-based lookups via B-tree indexes cover all resolution use cases.
    46→- Adding HNSW would introduce unnecessary KNN+WHERE split workaround complexity for zero benefit.
    47→- If multi-tenant workspaces with many members emerge later, adding an HNSW index is a single migration line.
    48→
    49→### Why breaking schema change (no data migration)
    50→
    51→**Decision**: Per project convention, schema changes are breaking. No backfill scripts.
    52→
    53→**Rationale**:
    54→- AGENTS.md: "This project does NOT maintain backwards compatibility with existing data."
    55→- Identity bootstrap runs on workspace creation -- fresh data on next setup.
    56→- Eliminates migration script complexity and rollback risk.
    57→
    58→## SurrealDB Constraints and Workarounds
    59→
    60→| Constraint | Impact | Workaround |
    61→|-----------|--------|------------|
    62→| KNN + WHERE bug | Not applicable — identity table has no HNSW index (low cardinality, B-tree only) | N/A |
    63→| SCHEMAFULL conditional fields | Cannot enforce "agent_type required when type=agent" on single table | Hub-spoke: agent-specific fields on separate `agent` table with its own SCHEMAFULL |
    64→| DEFINE ANALYZER outside transaction | If identity gets fulltext index, analyzer must precede BEGIN TRANSACTION | Place DEFINE ANALYZER before transaction block in migration |
    65→| No ALTER TABLE ADD FIELD | Adding identity_id to session | Use DEFINE FIELD OVERWRITE |
    66→| search::score in functions | If identity gets fulltext search | Run from app layer (existing pattern) |

   610→\subsection{RQ1: Token Budget Composition and Visibility}
   611→\label{sec:rq1}
   612→
   613→\textit{Analytical result.} Equation~1 decomposes total token consumption into five categories. In a realistic VS~Code session (Example~1, Section~\ref{sec:examples}), a developer with 23 open tabs consumed 85,200 tokens against a 200,000-token budget. Applying \texttt{@tokalator /breakdown} revealed that 18,000 tokens (21\%) came from 12 configuration files with relevance $R < 0.3$, and a single \texttt{.github/copilot-instructions.md} file contributed 4,200 tokens (5\%) silently injected into every prompt. After running \texttt{/optimize}, total context dropped to 67,200 tokens (33,600 fewer, a 21.2\% reduction from the pre-optimization total). This confirms that instruction files and low-relevance configuration tabs are significant and systematically invisible budget consumers.
   614→
   615→\textit{User-study evidence (RQ1).} In our deployment at iLab / Kariyer.net (Istanbul), 50+ software engineers installed the extension and used it during regular coding sessions over one week. %% RISKY CLAIM: "All participants" — universal quantifier over an informal, uncontrolled
   616→%% deployment (n≈50, no formal survey instrument, no IRB, selection bias: all participants
   617→%% voluntarily installed the tool). Reviewer may flag this as anecdotal. Soften to
   618→%% "Participants consistently reported..." or cite a formal survey if one exists.
   619→\hl{Participants consistently reported that they had not previously known how many tokens instruction files consumed.} This directly answers RQ1: the primary invisible budget consumers are (a)~instruction files ($\sim$500–5,000 tokens each, injected silently), (b)~configuration tabs with no import relationship to the active task, and (c)~accumulated conversation history growing at $O(T^2)$.
   620→
   621→\textit{Community validation.} Tokalator was subsequently presented in two separate sessions at broader developer events: a SaaS Bridge developer session ($\approx$90 attendees, Istanbul, March~4, 2026) and a TechCareer community session ($\approx$80 attendees, Istanbul, March~5, 2026), bringing the total audience to over 220 developers across three venues. Both sessions included live demonstrations of the VS~Code extension and web calculators, followed by structured Q\&A. Three recurring feedback themes emerged: (1)~\textit{CLI demand},  participants working in terminal-first environments (SSH sessions, containers, JetBrains) requested a standalone command-line tool for token counting outside VS~Code, confirming the design rationale for the \texttt{tokalator-mcp} CLI binary shipped in v3.1.1; (2)~\textit{turn-count visibility},  several attendees asked for a per-turn remaining-budget indicator showing estimated turns left before the conversation exhausts the context limit, which maps to the \texttt{preview\_turn} MCP tool; and (3)~\textit{minor bugs}, edge cases including stale token counts after rapid file switching, duplicate tab entries in multi-root workspaces, and pin/unpin state persistence \hl{were reported and subsequently fixed in v3.1.2: (a)~stale token counts caused by a dropped refresh when \texttt{isRefreshing} was true, resolved via a \texttt{pendingRefresh} flag; (b)~duplicate tab entries in multi-root workspaces caused by iterating all tab groups without URI deduplication, fixed by adding a \texttt{seenUris} Set and matching workspace folders by path instead of always using the first folder; (c)~\texttt{/pin} and \texttt{/unpin} state reversion: pinned files intermittently reverted to scored mode after tab switching, caused by the pin set not being re-hydrated from \texttt{workspaceState} on tab-change events — fixed March~6, 2026 by persisting the pin set on every mutation.}

693→\section{Discussion}
   694→\label{sec:discussion}
   695→
   696→\subsection{Interpretation of Results}
   697→
   698→The three research questions share a common finding: token budget consumption in AI-assisted development is large, invisible by default, and highly manageable once made visible. The 21.2\% context reduction in Example~1 came entirely from removing files the developer had not intentionally included as context --- they were simply open tabs accumulated across a working session. Similarly, the 88.9\% daily cost saving in Example~2 was available to any team using a 50K-token system prompt, but only became actionable when the break-even calculation was presented concretely. These results suggest that the primary barrier to context efficiency is not developer motivation but information availability.
   699→
   700→The survey results reinforce this: 82\% of respondents named \texttt{/preview} as their most-valued feature, not because it changes what the model sees, but because it makes the cost of the next turn observable before it is incurred. This aligns with the broader literature on decision support systems: making a cost function explicit and real-time tends to shift behavior even without enforcement \citep{bergemann2025economics}.
   701→
   702→The model synchronization issue (64\% of users affected) highlights a structural gap in how current AI coding tools expose their state: developers switch models in the Copilot UI without any notification to companion tools. Tokalator's v3.1.2 auto-sync addresses this at the extension level, but a standard API for broadcasting active model changes across IDE extensions would benefit the entire ecosystem.
   703→
   704→\subsection{Practical Implications}
   705→
   706→For development teams adopting AI coding assistants, the findings from this work suggest four actionable guidelines:
   707→
   708→\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*]
   709→  \item \textit{Audit instruction files first.} A \texttt{CLAUDE.md} or \texttt{.github/copilot-instructions.md} file is injected silently into every prompt. A 4,000-token instruction file costs the same as 4,000 tokens of source code --- but applies to every single request. Teams should treat instruction files as high-ROI targets for context reduction.
   710→  \item \textit{Enable prompt caching for any system prompt used more than twice per day.} The break-even point for Anthropic models is two reuses. For OpenAI's automatic caching, the mechanism is always-on. Any team running a chatbot or agent with a fixed system prompt is losing money by not caching.
   711→  \item \textit{Use sliding-window or summarize strategies for conversations longer than 20 turns.} Full-history cost grows quadratically; switching to a 5-turn sliding window triples the number of affordable turns within the same daily budget (28 vs.\ 83 turns in Example~3).
   712→  \item \textit{Close distractor tabs before starting a coding session.} Configuration files (\texttt{.json}, \texttt{.yml}) open alongside active source files contribute tokens without providing useful context for most coding tasks. Running \texttt{@tokalator /optimize} at session start is a low-effort habit that reduces per-request cost immediately.
   713→\end{enumerate}
   714→
   715→\subsection{Threats to Validity}
   716→
   717→\textit{Internal validity.} The relevance score weights ($w_\mathrm{lang}=0.25$, $w_\mathrm{import}=0.30$, $w_\mathrm{path}=0.20$, $w_\mathrm{recency}=0.15$, $w_\mathrm{diag}=0.10$) were set by design reasoning, not measured against data. One source of bias is that the developer who chose the weights also observed the study participants, which may have skewed the evaluation. Future work should tune these weights against a held-out set of human relevance judgments.
   718→
   719→\textit{Construct validity.} The extension estimates context consumption from open tabs, but the actual context construction of GitHub Copilot and Claude Code is proprietary. The extension's token count is an upper-bound proxy, not a direct measurement. All reported figures (e.g., ``21\% reduction'') reflect estimated consumption, not confirmed API-level context size.
   720→
   721→\textit{External validity.} The user study ran at three venues: Kariyer.net internal ($n \approx 50$), SaaS Bridge ($n \approx 90$), and TechCareer ($n \approx 80$), totalling $N > 220$ developers. The internal group shared a similar TypeScript/React stack; the community sessions had a wider mix of languages and roles. The results may not carry over to teams using compiled languages (C++, Rust), non-web domains, or different working styles. The sample is large enough to identify recurring feedback themes but not for statistical generalization.
   722→
   723→\textit{Reliability.} The Cobb--Douglas sensitivity parameters ($\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$) are placeholder values satisfying structural constraints ($\alpha + \beta + \gamma < 1$) but not calibrated from empirical data. Users relying on the Economic Analysis tool for investment decisions should treat its outputs as directional guidance, not precise predictions.
   724→
   725→\section{Limitations}
   726→\label{sec:limitations}
   727→
   728→The toolkit has several limitations worth noting.
   729→
   730→\textit{(i) Approximate tokenization for Google models:} The extension uses a heuristic of approximately 4 characters per token for Gemini models, as Google does not provide a client-side BPE tokenizer for JavaScript. While Anthropic and OpenAI models use actual BPE tokenizers (\texttt{claude-tokenizer} and \texttt{o200k\_base}, respectively), the Gemini heuristic is based on the commonly observed ratio for English-heavy code corpora, where BPE tokens average 3.5 to 4.5 characters. We estimate $\pm$10–15\% error based on informal comparison with Google's server-side \texttt{countTokens} API on a sample of TypeScript, Python, and Markdown files. Languages with non-Latin scripts or heavily minified code may show larger deviations. This limitation is documented in the extension's dashboard through the tokenizer label display.
   731→
   732→\textit{(ii) Extension performance overhead:} The extension subscribes to six VS Code event streams: active editor, tab changes, document edits, document open and close, diagnostics, and configuration changes. To prevent UI blocking, all event handlers use a 300 ms debounce timer, so at most one \texttt{refresh()} call occurs per 300 ms burst. Token counts are cached per document, keyed by URI and version number; re-tokenization occurs only when the document content changes. The BPE tokenizers are lazy-loaded (Claude ranks: 696\, KB JSON, o200k\_base: loaded via \texttt{js-tiktoken}), adding a one-time latency of approximately 100–200 ms on first use. A periodic background refresh (default 2 s, configurable) updates recency-based scores. In informal testing with over 30 open tabs,
   733→the extension contributes less than 5 ms per snapshot build after the initial tokenizer warm-up, which is imperceptible to the user.
   734→
   735→\textit{(iii) Syntactic rather than semantic relevance:}
   736→The tab relevance scorer (Equation~2) uses structural signals --- import graphs, path similarity, language match, edit recency, and diagnostics --- not semantic understanding. A file that is conceptually important (e.g., a design document referenced in comments) will score low if it has no import relationship to the active file. Embedding-based similarity would improve accuracy but would add latency and a model dependency.

   110→**Key Patterns:**
   111→- Each agent implements `Agent` interface with `finder` (SessionFinder) and `parser` (LineParser)
   112→- **SessionFinder interface** includes optional methods for super-follow:
   113→  - `getProjectInfo(sessionPath)` - Extract project context from session
   114→  - `findLatestInProject(projectDir)` - Find newest session in same project
   115→- SessionFinder locates session files in agent-specific directories:
   116→  - Codex: `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl` (all projects mixed, cwd in session_meta)
   117→  - Claude: `~/.claude/projects/{encoded-path}/{UUID}.jsonl` (per-project directory)
   118→  - Gemini: `~/.gemini/tmp/{hash或name}/chats/session-*.json` (.project_root for project info)
   119→- FileWatcher supports two modes: JSONL (line-by-line) and JSON (whole-file, for Gemini)
   120→- **Super Follow** (`createSuperFollowController`): Auto-switch to latest session, configurable per-agent via `findLatestInProject` callback
   121→- **Codex Session Cache**: Cwd-indexed cache with 2s incremental refresh (scans today's directory only)
   122→- Formatters transform ParsedLine to output string (raw JSON or pretty colored)
   123→- **Pane auto-open** (`--pane`): Uses `SubagentDetector` hooks → `PaneManager` → `TerminalController` to open tmux panes for subagent create/resume, and closes on `toolUseResult`. Requires tmux environment.
   124→  - `onNewSubagent`: Fired on subagent **create** (via `registerNewAgent`)
   125→  - `onSubagentEnter`: Fired on subagent **resume** (via `handleAgentProgress` when agentId already known)
   126→  - Both callbacks point to same `openPaneForSubagent` function; `PaneManager.openPane` guards against duplicate panes
   127→- **Pane naming**: Task `description` is extracted from `tool_use` input, queued in `SubagentDetector` (FIFO), and matched to new agents. `PaneManager` sanitizes and applies via `tmux select-pane -T` (2.6+, best-effort). Known limitation: parallel Tasks may mismatch descriptions.
   128→
   129→**Adding Super Follow to a New Agent:**
   130→1. Implement `getProjectInfo(sessionPath)` - Return `{ projectDir, displayName }` for the session
   131→2. Implement `findLatestInProject(projectDir)` - Find newest session in same project scope
   132→3. Add agent-specific logic to `startSingleWatch` in `src/index.ts`
   133→
   134→**Codex Subagent Detection (Phases 1-3 complete):**
   135→- **Event-driven only** (no directory watch): Codex日期目錄混合多個使用者的主 session，無法用 fs.watch 過濾。偵測靠解析主 session JSONL 的 `spawn_agent` + `function_call_output` 事件。
   136→- **UUID format**: Codex subagent ID 是 UUID v7（`019cc375-5af5-7ed1-9ff8-8a5757d815d1`），不同於 Claude 的 7-40 hex。`isValidCodexAgentId` 用 UUID regex 驗證。
   137→- **Flat directory**: subagent JSONL 和主 session 在同一個日期目錄（非巢狀）。`dirname(mainSessionPath)` 即日期目錄。
   138→- **Label collision gotcha**: UUID v7 前兩段都是 timestamp。`makeCodexAgentLabel` 改用 `parts[0]` + `parts[4].slice(0,4)`（node segment）避免同毫秒碰撞。
   139→- **All CLI options supported**: `--with-subagents`、`--subagent`、`--all`、`--pane`、`--interactive` 現在同時支援 `claude` 和 `codex`。
   140→- **Shared interfaces in core**: `OutputHandler`、`WatcherHandler`、`SessionHandler` 等介面在 `src/core/detector-interfaces.ts`，Claude module 透過 re-export 向後相容。
   141→- **Stateless parser in interactive mode**: Codex parser 無狀態，`startCodexInteractiveWatch` 所有 session 共用 `sharedParser`（Claude 每 session 需獨立 parser 防止狀態污染）。
   142→- **registerExistingAgent() required for resume**: 啟動時已知的 subagent 必須呼叫 `detector.registerExistingAgent(agentId, path)` 預填路徑，否則 `resume_agent` 事件的 `handleSubagentResume` 找不到路徑，`onSubagentEnter` 不會觸發。
   143→- **stopped flag prevents cross-session contamination**: `CodexSubagentDetector.stop()` 設定 `stopped = true`，`_resolveSubagent` 在每個 await 點後檢查，防止舊 detector 的 in-flight resolve 污染新 session 的 watcher。
   144→- **`handleSpawnAgentOutput` skips pre-registered agents**: 啟動時透過 `registerExistingAgent` 預填的 agentId，在歷史行重播時 `handleSpawnAgentOutput` 會跳過（避免對已知 subagent 重複 resolve + 重複 `onNewSubagent`）。
   145→- **Codex pane output filter needs shortId→fullId mapping**: Codex label 用短 ID（`019cc375-8a57`），但 `PaneManager` 用完整 UUID 作 key。`shouldOutput` 需透過 `shortIdToFullId` Map 反查。此映射在 `switchToSession` 時 `clear()`，並由 `prefillExistingSubagents` 和 `openPaneForSubagent` 填充。
   146→- **Use `RetryConfig` for retry loops**: `src/core/detector-interfaces.ts` 定義了 `RetryConfig` 介面（maxRetries, retryDelay, initialDelay）。Codex 的 `SUBAGENT_FILE_RETRY` 和 Claude 的 `EARLY_DETECTION_RETRY` / `FALLBACK_DETECTION_RETRY` 都應使用此介面，避免 magic numbers。
   147→
   148→**Gotchas:**
   149→- **Gemini parser has state** (`processedMessageIds`). Must recreate parser when switching sessions to avoid message skip bugs.

     2→
     3→macOS image viewer (AppKit, Swift 6.2, arm64, Xcode 26).
     4→Replaces XEE. Core flow: Finder right-click → Open With → folder browse → pinch zoom.
     5→
     6→## Build & Test
     7→
     8→```bash
     9→xcodegen generate          # regenerate .xcodeproj after project.yml changes
    10→xcodebuild -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -configuration Debug build
    11→xcodebuild test -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:CeeTests
    12→./scripts/test-e2e.sh      # XCUITest suite
    13→```
    14→
    15→Debug: `CEE_DEBUG_CENTERING=1` env var or `--debug-centering` flag.
    16→
    17→## Key Conventions
    18→
    19→- **No XIB/Storyboard** — all UI is programmatic.
    20→- **Entry point** — `main.swift` (not `@main`/`@NSApplicationMain`).
    21→- **Multi-instance window support** — `ImageWindowController.windows` (array) replaces the old `shared` singleton. `reuseWindow` setting (default `true`) controls whether new files open in the same window or a new one.
    22→- **project.yml** — source of truth for Xcode project. `.xcodeproj` is gitignored.
    23→- **Test targets** — `CeeTests` (unit) and `CeeUITests` (E2E). `TestHelpers.swift` provides shared `minimalPNG()`, `createJPEG(width:height:)`, `createPNG(width:height:)`.
    24→- **URL comparison gotcha** — `URL ==` can fail between manually constructed URLs and URLs from `contentsOfDirectory`. Use `.path` comparison.
    25→
    26→## Swift 6 Gotchas
    27→
    28→- **`ImageLoader` is an `actor`** — never pass `ImageFolder` (non-Sendable) across actor boundaries. Use `ImageItem` (Sendable).
    29→- **`setMagnification(_:centeredAt:)`** — parameter label is `centeredAt:`, not `centeredAtPoint:`.
    30→- **Protocol + @MainActor** — delegate protocols called from NSScrollView subclasses must be marked `@MainActor`.
    31→- **NSScrollView unflipped coordinates** — visual top = high Y, visual bottom = low Y.
    32→- **NSScrollView `contentInsets` visual semantics** — `.top` = visual top (high Y), `.bottom` = visual bottom (low Y). In `scrollRange`: `minY = -insets.bottom`, `maxY = docH - clipH + insets.top`.
    33→- **CALayer y-axis flipped in layer-backed NSView** — `wantsLayer = true` → `y=0` is visual top. Opposite of raw Core Animation.
    34→- **`deinit` cannot access stored properties** in strict concurrency. Use notification-based cleanup.
    35→- **CGImageSource pixel dimensions ignore EXIF orientation** — `kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth/Height` report raw sensor dimensions. For orientation 5-8, swap w/h. Thumbnails with `kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true` are auto-rotated, but `fullSize` is not.
    36→- **`@objc func` + default parameter + menu action** — `@objc func foo(amount: Int = 1)` gets ObjC selector `fooWithAmount:`. AppKit passes `NSMenuItem` pointer as the argument → huge `Int`. Fix: separate `@objc` action from internal impl.
    37→
    38→## XcodeGen Gotchas
    39→
    40→- **Unit test bundle type is `bundle.unit-test`**, not `bundle.unit-testing`. UI test is `bundle.ui-testing`.
    41→- **`GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES`** required for test targets without custom Info.plist.
    42→- **Xcode 26 debug dylib** — `ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB` splits app into stub + `Cee.debug.dylib`. Requires `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: YES` with ad-hoc signing, otherwise dylib fails system policy.
    43→- **Signing / test failures** — If CodeSign fails ("code object is not signed at all" in test bundle, or dylib system policy) or tests fail to run: run `xcodegen generate` then `xcodebuild clean build`. Regenerating syncs project.yml; clean build refreshes stale signatures. Incremental builds can leave dylib/test bundle signatures out of sync.
    44→
    45→## AppKit Gotchas
    46→
    47→- **Cmd-shortcuts vs keyDown** — `performKeyEquivalent` fires before `keyDown`. Cmd-modified → menu items; bare keys → `ImageScrollView.keyDown`.
    48→- **Never put `keyDown` on NSViewController when NSScrollView is first responder.** NSScrollView intercepts arrow/Space/PageUp/PageDown. Override on NSScrollView subclass.
    49→- **`NSMenuItemValidation`** — protocol conformance, not `override`.
    50→- **Overlay event passthrough** — display-only overlays override `hitTest` → `nil`. For drag-drop, child `NSImageView` must call `unregisterDraggedTypes()` to prevent intercepting parent's drag session.
    51→- **NSVisualEffectView + alpha animation** — animating `alphaValue` causes material compositing flash. Use plain `layer.backgroundColor` with semi-transparent color instead.
    52→- **NSCollectionView re-enables scrollers** during layout/reloadData. Override getter+setter in subclass to lock off; simple property assignment is insufficient.
    53→- **NSCollectionView `didSelectItemsAt` fires on arrow keys** — filter with `NSApp.currentEvent?.type == .leftMouseUp` for click-only. Arrow key selection does NOT auto-scroll; call `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` manually in the else branch.
    54→- **NSCollectionView `scrollToItems` unreliable** — use `layoutAttributesForItem(at:)?.frame` + `scrollToVisible(_:)` instead for reliable programmatic scrolling.
    55→- **NSCollectionView internal auto-scroll during selection** — `NSCollectionView` calls `scrollToItems` internally after selection changes (arrow keys). Suppress by overriding `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` in a subclass with a `suppressAutoScroll` flag; set the flag around your own scroll calls so only your animation runs.
    56→- **NSCollectionView scrollbar + `availableLayoutWidth`** — When using a legacy always-visible scrollbar (`VisibleScroller` subclass), use `contentView.bounds.width` for `availableLayoutWidth`, not `bounds.width`, to account for the scroller's width.
    57→- **CALayer border clipping in NSCollectionView cells** — `borderWidth` draws half inside, half outside bounds. With `masksToBounds = true` + adjacent cell overlap, borders get clipped. Fix: inset highlightLayer frame by `borderWidth/2` so border is fully inside bounds; set `zPosition` high to render above subview layers.
    58→- **`NSCollectionViewPrefetching` doesn't exist in AppKit** — UIKit-only.
    59→
    60→## XCUITest Gotchas
    61→
    62→- **NSScrollView accessibility** — only `setAccessibilityIdentifier`; never override `.scrollArea` role.
    63→- **Bare key events unreliable.** Use Cmd-modified menu shortcuts.
    64→- **Always assert `XCTWaiter` result** — `.wait(...)` returns `.timedOut` silently.
    65→
    66→## Centering & Zoom
    67→
    68→- **Never sync fullscreen with fixed delays.** Use `didEnterFullScreen`/`didExitFullScreen` notifications.
    69→- **Centering math: one coordinate space.** Never divide `statusBarH` by magnification.
    70→- **Anchor out-of-bounds** — When anchor lies outside document bounds, use document center. Clamping causes rightward bias.
    71→- **`isZooming` flag** suppresses force-recenter during zoom to preserve pan position.
    72→- **resizeToFitImage below min** — When target < window minimum, early return to avoid drift.
    73→
    74→## Scroll & Page-Turn
    75→
    76→- **Trackpad vs mouse wheel** — Detect via `event.phase != [] || event.momentumPhase != []`. Thresholds: trackpad ~130pt, wheel ~20pt.
    77→- **Trackpad page-turn: edge-start + accumulate + once-per-gesture.** Momentum lock 0.6s after turn. `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` flag blocks the entire old scroll sequence until a fresh `phase=.began && momentumPhase=[]` gesture.
    78→- **NSScrollView fallback deceleration** — If momentum events are blocked without calling `super.scrollWheel`, NSScrollView detects disrupted momentum tracking and launches its own fallback deceleration animation after `momentumPhase=.ended`, directly manipulating clipView and bypassing `scrollWheel` override entirely. Fix: still call `super.scrollWheel` for momentum events; suppress visual movement by overriding `reflectScrolledClipView` to clamp position to top/bottom. Use `isEnforcingScrollPosition` guard to prevent recursion. **Critical**: do NOT add an `isInScrollWheelHandler` guard to `reflectScrolledClipView` — CoreAnimation-driven fallback updates happen outside `scrollWheel`, so the guard would let them bypass the clamp and cause half-page drift.     82→
    83→- **`ImageContentView` uses `layer.contents = cgImage`**, not `draw()`. GPU affine transform for zoom.
    84→- **`wantsUpdateLayer = true`** — never mix with `draw()`.

    87→## Dual Page View
    88→
    89→- **`DualPageContentView`** is permanent documentView. Use `currentDocumentSize` for fitting, not `contentView.image?.size`.
    90→- **`contentView` is computed** — `dualPageView.leadingPage`.

    94→## Drag-Drop

    96→- **`folder` is optional** (~17 guard-let sites). Empty state: `EmptyStateView` overlay with drag support.

1→# Cee — CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→macOS image viewer (AppKit, Swift 6.2, arm64, Xcode 26).
     4→Replaces XEE. Core flow: Finder right-click → Open With → folder browse → pinch zoom.
     5→
     6→## Build & Test
     7→
     8→```bash
     9→xcodegen generate          # regenerate .xcodeproj after project.yml changes
    10→xcodebuild -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -configuration Debug build
    11→xcodebuild test -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:CeeTests
    12→./scripts/test-e2e.sh      # XCUITest suite
    13→```
    14→
    15→Debug: `CEE_DEBUG_CENTERING=1` env var or `--debug-centering` flag.
    16→
    17→## Key Conventions
    18→
    19→- **No XIB/Storyboard** — all UI is programmatic.
    20→- **Entry point** — `main.swift` (not `@main`/`@NSApplicationMain`).
    21→- **Multi-instance window support** — `ImageWindowController.windows` (array) replaces the old `shared` singleton. `reuseWindow` setting (default `true`) controls whether new files open in the same window or a new one.
    22→- **project.yml** — source of truth for Xcode project. `.xcodeproj` is gitignored.
    23→- **Test targets** — `CeeTests` (unit) and `CeeUITests` (E2E). `TestHelpers.swift` provides shared `minimalPNG()`, `createJPEG(width:height:)`, `createPNG(width:height:)`.
    24→- **URL comparison gotcha** — `URL ==` can fail between manually constructed URLs and URLs from `contentsOfDirectory`. Use `.path` comparison.
    25→
    26→## Swift 6 Gotchas
    27→
    28→- **`ImageLoader` is an `actor`** — never pass `ImageFolder` (non-Sendable) across actor boundaries. Use `ImageItem` (Sendable).
    29→- **`setMagnification(_:centeredAt:)`** — parameter label is `centeredAt:`, not `centeredAtPoint:`.
    30→- **Protocol + @MainActor** — delegate protocols called from NSScrollView subclasses must be marked `@MainActor`.
    31→- **NSScrollView unflipped coordinates** — visual top = high Y, visual bottom = low Y.
    32→- **NSScrollView `contentInsets` visual semantics** — `.top` = visual top (high Y), `.bottom` = visual bottom (low Y). In `scrollRange`: `minY = -insets.bottom`, `maxY = docH - clipH + insets.top`.
    33→- **CALayer y-axis flipped in layer-backed NSView** — `wantsLayer = true` → `y=0` is visual top. Opposite of raw Core Animation.
    34→- **`deinit` cannot access stored properties** in strict concurrency. Use notification-based cleanup.
    35→- **CGImageSource pixel dimensions ignore EXIF orientation** — `kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth/Height` report raw sensor dimensions. For orientation 5-8, swap w/h. Thumbnails with `kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true` are auto-rotated, but `fullSize` is not.
    36→- **`@objc func` + default parameter + menu action** — `@objc func foo(amount: Int = 1)` gets ObjC selector `fooWithAmount:`. AppKit passes `NSMenuItem` pointer as the argument → huge `Int`. Fix: separate `@objc` action from internal impl.
    37→
    38→## XcodeGen Gotchas
    39→
    40→- **Unit test bundle type is `bundle.unit-test`**, not `bundle.unit-testing`. UI test is `bundle.ui-testing`.
    41→- **`GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES`** required for test targets without custom Info.plist.
    42→- **Xcode 26 debug dylib** — `ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB` splits app into stub + `Cee.debug.dylib`. Requires `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: YES` with ad-hoc signing, otherwise dylib fails system policy.
    43→- **Signing / test failures** — If CodeSign fails ("code object is not signed at all" in test bundle, or dylib system policy) or tests fail to run: run `xcodegen generate` then `xcodebuild clean build`. Regenerating syncs project.yml; clean build refreshes stale signatures. Incremental builds can leave dylib/test bundle signatures out of sync.
    44→
    45→## AppKit Gotchas
    46→
    47→- **Cmd-shortcuts vs keyDown** — `performKeyEquivalent` fires before `keyDown`. Cmd-modified → menu items; bare keys → `ImageScrollView.keyDown`.
    48→- **Never put `keyDown` on NSViewController when NSScrollView is first responder.** NSScrollView intercepts arrow/Space/PageUp/PageDown. Override on NSScrollView subclass.
    49→- **`NSMenuItemValidation`** — protocol conformance, not `override`.
    50→- **Overlay event passthrough** — display-only overlays override `hitTest` → `nil`. For drag-drop, child `NSImageView` must call `unregisterDraggedTypes()` to prevent intercepting parent's drag session.
    51→- **NSVisualEffectView + alpha animation** — animating `alphaValue` causes material compositing flash. Use plain `layer.backgroundColor` with semi-transparent color instead.
    52→- **NSCollectionView re-enables scrollers** during layout/reloadData. Override getter+setter in subclass to lock off; simple property assignment is insufficient.
    53→- **NSCollectionView `didSelectItemsAt` fires on arrow keys** — filter with `NSApp.currentEvent?.type == .leftMouseUp` for click-only. Arrow key selection does NOT auto-scroll; call `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` manually in the else branch.
    54→- **NSCollectionView `scrollToItems` unreliable** — use `layoutAttributesForItem(at:)?.frame` + `scrollToVisible(_:)` instead for reliable programmatic scrolling.
    55→- **NSCollectionView internal auto-scroll during selection** — `NSCollectionView` calls `scrollToItems` internally after selection changes (arrow keys). Suppress by overriding `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` in a subclass with a `suppressAutoScroll` flag; set the flag around your own scroll calls so only your animation runs.
    56→- **NSCollectionView scrollbar + `availableLayoutWidth`** — When using a legacy always-visible scrollbar (`VisibleScroller` subclass), use `contentView.bounds.width` for `availableLayoutWidth`, not `bounds.width`, to account for the scroller's width.
    57→- **CALayer border clipping in NSCollectionView cells** — `borderWidth` draws half inside, half outside bounds. With `masksToBounds = true` + adjacent cell overlap, borders get clipped. Fix: inset highlightLayer frame by `borderWidth/2` so border is fully inside bounds; set `zPosition` high to render above subview layers.
    58→- **`NSCollectionViewPrefetching` doesn't exist in AppKit** — UIKit-only.
    59→- **`setMagnification` synchronously triggers `reflectScrolledClipView`** — Any state that must be set before the scroll/magnify callback (e.g., zoom suppression flags) must be set BEFORE calling `setMagnification`, not after. The delegate callback (`scrollViewMagnificationDidChange`) fires even later.
    60→
    61→## XCUITest Gotchas
    62→
    63→- **NSScrollView accessibility** — only `setAccessibilityIdentifier`; never override `.scrollArea` role.
    64→- **Bare key events unreliable.** Use Cmd-modified menu shortcuts.
    65→- **Always assert `XCTWaiter` result** — `.wait(...)` returns `.timedOut` silently.
    66→
    67→## Centering & Zoom
    68→
    69→- **Never sync fullscreen with fixed delays.** Use `didEnterFullScreen`/`didExitFullScreen` notifications.
    70→- **Centering math: one coordinate space.** Never divide `statusBarH` by magnification.
    71→- **Anchor out-of-bounds** — When anchor lies outside document bounds, use document center. Clamping causes rightward bias.
    72→- **`isZooming` flag** suppresses force-recenter during zoom to preserve pan position.
    73→- **resizeToFitImage below min** — When target < window minimum, early return to avoid drift.
    74→
    75→## Scroll & Page-Turn
    76→
    77→- **Trackpad vs mouse wheel** — Detect via `event.phase != [] || event.momentumPhase != []`. Thresholds: trackpad 80–250pt, wheel 10–40pt (3-tier sensitivity).
    78→- **Trackpad page-turn: edge-start + accumulate + once-per-gesture.** Momentum lock 0.6s after turn. `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` flag blocks the entire old scroll sequence until a fresh `phase=.began && momentumPhase=[]` gesture.
    79→- **Momentum must not accumulate for page-turn** — Momentum delta is massive; if accumulated, all sensitivity levels feel identical. Exclude via early `return` inside `if isTrackpad`, NOT via `if isTrackpad && !isMomentumEvent` — the latter causes momentum to fall into the `else` mouse-wheel branch which lacks `gestureBeganAtEdge` protection, breaking the "extra swipe at edge" requirement.
    80→- **NSScrollView fallback deceleration** — If momentum events are blocked without calling `super.scrollWheel`, NSScrollView detects disrupted momentum tracking and launches its own fallback deceleration animation after `momentumPhase=.ended`, directly manipulating clipView and bypassing `scrollWheel` override entirely. Fix: still call `super.scrollWheel` for momentum events; suppress visual movement by overriding `reflectScrolledClipView` to clamp position to top/bottom. Use `isEnforcingScrollPosition` guard to prevent recursion. **Critical**: do NOT add an `isInScrollWheelHandler` guard to `reflectScrolledClipView` — CoreAnimation-driven fallback updates happen outside `scrollWheel`, so the guard would let them bypass the clamp and cause half-page drift. Instead, rely on clearing `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` on `momentumPhase=.ended` to re-enable arrow keys/programmatic scroll after momentum finishes.
    81→- **`isAtTop`/`isAtBottom` must use `yScrollBounds(contentInsets)`** — comparing directly against `docFrame.height` ignores `contentInsets` and causes premature page-turn trigger when status bar padding is non-zero. Always derive top/bottom thresholds via `yScrollBounds` for consistency with `reflectScrolledClipView` clamp logic.
    82→- **Keyboard nav** — Arrow left/right and up/down are separate toggles. 3 extra presses at edge for arrows; 1 for PageUp/PageDown/Space.
    83→
    84→## GPU Rendering
    85→
    86→- **`ImageContentView` uses `layer.contents = cgImage`**, not `draw()`. GPU affine transform for zoom.
    87→- **`wantsUpdateLayer = true`** — never mix with `draw()`.
    88→- **Error placeholder** must be added to `self.view`, NOT `scrollView` — clipView covers subviews.
    89→
    90→## Dual Page View
    91→
    92→- **`DualPageContentView`** is permanent documentView. Use `currentDocumentSize` for fitting, not `contentView.image?.size`.
    93→- **`contentView` is computed** — `dualPageView.leadingPage`.
    94→- **All loading goes through `loadSpread`** — single mode wraps as `.single`.
    95→- **`imageSizeCache`** — index-based. Unknown sizes default to portrait. Clear on folder change.
    96→
    97→## Drag-Drop
    98→
    99→- **`folder` is optional** (~17 guard-let sites). Empty state: `EmptyStateView` overlay with drag support.
   100→- **Folder drops** — Use `ImageFolder(folderURL:)` (not `appendingPathComponent(".")` — breaks `deletingLastPathComponent()`).
   101→- **Subfolder discovery** — `init(folderURL:)` auto-searches up to 2 levels (BFS) when top-level has no images.
   102→
   103→## Fast Browse
   104→
   105→- **`ImageLoader.loadThumbnail`** returns `(image, fullSize)` tuple. `ThumbnailCacheKey(url, maxSize)` composite key isolates grid vs main view caches. `priority` parameter (default `.userInitiated`) allows `.utility` for buffer cells. Throttled by `ThumbnailThrottle` actor (max 4 concurrent). **Known issue**: `fullSize` doesn't handle EXIF orientation — rotated images report swapped dimensions.
   106→- **Navigation throttle** ~20fps; `scheduleFullResLoad` 100ms after last key. Full-res must use scroll intent (`.top`/`.bottom`), never `.preserve`.
   107→- **Thumbnail fallback is opt-in** — `settings.thumbnailFallback` (default off).
   108→- **`applyInitialScrollPosition`** must run after `applyCenteringInsetsIfNeeded`. For `.bottom`, defer one frame.
   109→- **Option+scroll** — `OptionScrollAccumulator` with separate trackpad/mouse thresholds. Mouse delta ×10 sensitivity, steps clamped to 1, time-based reset (0.3s). Must intercept BEFORE `pageTurnLockUntil` check.
   110→
   111→## Quick Grid
   112→
   113→- **`QuickGridView`** — NSCollectionView overlay (G key toggle). Grid-local thumbnail cache separate from `ImageLoader.thumbnailCache`.
   114→- **Grid cell resize** — Pinch, Cmd+Scroll, Cmd+=+-, slider. All route through `applyItemSize()` → `invalidateLayout()` (never `reloadData()`). Four thumbnail tiers: ≤tier0→adaptive (quantized 20px steps), ≤tier1→240px, ≤tier2→480px, >tier2→720px; tier change clears thumbnails + reloads.
   115→- **Dynamic cell aspect ratio** — `sampleMedianAspectRatio()` reads image headers (no decode). EXIF orientation 5-8 requires swapping w/h.
   116→- **Space-around layout** — `max(0, remaining)` + `floor(gap)` guards: negative remaining crashes FlowLayout; unrounded gaps cause line wrapping. Width-cache skips height-only recalcs.
   117→- **Grid persists across folder changes** — `clearCache()` + `configure()` instead of dismiss.
   118→- **Grid performance (Phase 1)** — `ThumbnailThrottle` actor limits concurrent decodes to 4. Scroll handler (20Hz) cancels non-visible tasks + evicts cache outside visible ± 50 buffer. Visible cells use `.userInitiated`, buffer cells `.utility`. Memory capped at 5% system RAM.
   119→- **Grid performance (Phase 2)** — Scroll-direction-aware prefetch (2 rows ahead), `MemoryPressureMonitor` (DispatchSource warning/critical), `generationID` stale-write guard on folder change, layer-backed cell optimization (`canDrawSubviewsIntoLayer` + `.onSetNeedsDisplay`).
   120→- **Keep-set cancel pattern** — When prefetch + cancel coexist, cancel must use `keepSet = visible ∪ prefetchRange`, not just visible indices. Otherwise prefetch tasks are immediately cancelled by the scroll handler.
   121→- **Generation ID pattern** — Int counter incremented on `clearCache()`, captured in Task closure, checked before cache write. Prevents stale folder thumbnails from overwriting new folder's cache. Same concept as `ImageViewController.currentLoadRequestID` (UUID) but simpler.
   122→- **DispatchSource idempotent start** — `DispatchSource.makeMemoryPressureSource` must guard `source == nil` before creating; repeated `start()` leaks un-cancelled sources.
   123→- **Reuse `NavigationThrottle`** — For any CFAbsoluteTime-based throttle (scroll handlers, etc.), use the existing `NavigationThrottle` struct instead of inline `lastTimestamp` + `guard` patterns.
   124→- **Grid performance (Phase 3.1-3.2)** — Tier0 adaptive resolution (`max(cellSize*scale, 80)` quantized to 20px steps) + `kCGImageSourceSubsampleFactor: 4` for JPEG/HEIF ≤120px. Priority dequeue in `ThumbnailThrottle` (smaller priority = higher urgency, FIFO tie-break). `cachedVisibleCenter` updated at 20Hz by scroll handler for `cellForItem` priority. Early `Task.isCancelled` guard after throttle acquire, before decode.
   125→- **`cachedVisibleCenter` pattern** — Avoid calling `indexPathsForVisibleItems()` per-cell in data source. Cache the visible center in the scroll handler (20Hz) and reuse in `cellForItem` + eviction. Initialize in `configure()` to `currentIndex`.
   126→- **Quantize to prevent cache churn** — When computed `maxSize` varies continuously (e.g., during pinch), quantize to fixed steps (`ceil(raw / step) * step`) so tier comparisons don't flush cache every frame.
   127→
   128→## Recent Significant Changes
   129→
   130→- **Trackpad page-turn momentum fix:** NSScrollView fallback deceleration animation bypasses `scrollWheel` override. Solved by passing momentum to super + `reflectScrolledClipView` clamp. `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` blocks old scroll sequence; `commitPageTurn(goingDown:)` unifies page-turn state. See "Scroll & Page-Turn" gotchas above.
   131→- **Click to turn page:** Single-click on left/right edge turns page (configurable in Navigation menu).
   132→- **Navigation menu:** New "Navigation" menu between View and Go. Reading mode (Dual Page, RTL) and nav settings (Arrow keys, Scroll to Bottom, page-turn sensitivity) moved there from View/Go menus.
   133→- **RTL nav + scroll settings:** `duoPageRTLNavigation` (default on) / `singlePageRTLNavigation` (default off) as independent settings; `effectiveRTLNavigation` picks based on current mode. `scrollToBottomOnPrevious` (default on) controls scroll position when navigating backward.
   134→- **Grid progressive tier reload:** Tier change no longer clears `gridThumbnails`; stale images stay visible until new tier finishes. `gridThumbnailSizes` tracks cached tier per index.
   135→- **Grid scrollbar:** Replaced overlay/autohide with legacy `VisibleScroller` subclass (always-visible, custom knob). `availableLayoutWidth` must use `contentView.bounds.width`.
   136→- **Multi-instance window support:** `ImageWindowController` now manages a `windows: [ImageWindowController]` array instead of a `shared` singleton. `reuseWindow: Bool` setting in `ViewerSettings` toggles behavior. `current` property prefers `NSApp.keyWindow` → `NSApp.mainWindow` → `windows.last`. 1→# Cee — CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→macOS image viewer (AppKit, Swift 6.2, arm64, Xcode 26).
     4→Replaces XEE. Core flow: Finder right-click → Open With → folder browse → pinch zoom.
     5→
     6→## Build & Test
     7→
     8→```bash
     9→xcodegen generate          # regenerate .xcodeproj after project.yml changes
    10→xcodebuild -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -configuration Debug build
    11→xcodebuild test -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:CeeTests
    12→./scripts/test-e2e.sh      # XCUITest suite
    13→```
    14→
    15→Debug: `CEE_DEBUG_CENTERING=1` env var or `--debug-centering` flag.
    16→
    17→## Key Conventions
    18→
    19→- **No XIB/Storyboard** — all UI is programmatic.
    20→- **Entry point** — `main.swift` (not `@main`/`@NSApplicationMain`).
    21→- **Multi-instance window support** — `ImageWindowController.windows` (array) replaces the old `shared` singleton. `reuseWindow` setting (default `true`) controls whether new files open in the same window or a new one.
    22→- **project.yml** — source of truth for Xcode project. `.xcodeproj` is gitignored.
    23→- **Test targets** — `CeeTests` (unit) and `CeeUITests` (E2E). `TestHelpers.swift` provides shared `minimalPNG()`, `createJPEG(width:height:)`, `createPNG(width:height:)`.
    24→- **URL comparison gotcha** — `URL ==` can fail between manually constructed URLs and URLs from `contentsOfDirectory`. Use `.path` comparison.
    25→
    26→## Swift 6 Gotchas
    27→
    28→- **`ImageLoader` is an `actor`** — never pass `ImageFolder` (non-Sendable) across actor boundaries. Use `ImageItem` (Sendable).
    29→- **`setMagnification(_:centeredAt:)`** — parameter label is `centeredAt:`, not `centeredAtPoint:`.
    30→- **Protocol + @MainActor** — delegate protocols called from NSScrollView subclasses must be marked `@MainActor`.
    31→- **NSScrollView unflipped coordinates** — visual top = high Y, visual bottom = low Y.
    32→- **NSScrollView `contentInsets` visual semantics** — `.top` = visual top (high Y), `.bottom` = visual bottom (low Y). In `scrollRange`: `minY = -insets.bottom`, `maxY = docH - clipH + insets.top`.
    33→- **CALayer y-axis flipped in layer-backed NSView** — `wantsLayer = true` → `y=0` is visual top. Opposite of raw Core Animation.
    34→- **`deinit` cannot access stored properties** in strict concurrency. Use notification-based cleanup.
    35→- **CGImageSource pixel dimensions ignore EXIF orientation** — `kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth/Height` report raw sensor dimensions. For orientation 5-8, swap w/h. Thumbnails with `kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true` are auto-rotated, but `fullSize` is not.
    36→- **`@objc func` + default parameter + menu action** — `@objc func foo(amount: Int = 1)` gets ObjC selector `fooWithAmount:`. AppKit passes `NSMenuItem` pointer as the argument → huge `Int`. Fix: separate `@objc` action from internal impl.
    37→
    38→## XcodeGen Gotchas
    39→
    40→- **Unit test bundle type is `bundle.unit-test`**, not `bundle.unit-testing`. UI test is `bundle.ui-testing`.
    41→- **`GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES`** required for test targets without custom Info.plist.
    42→- **Xcode 26 debug dylib** — `ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB` splits app into stub + `Cee.debug.dylib`. Requires `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: YES` with ad-hoc signing, otherwise dylib fails system policy.
    43→- **Signing / test failures** — If CodeSign fails ("code object is not signed at all" in test bundle, or dylib system policy) or tests fail to run: run `xcodegen generate` then `xcodebuild clean build`. Regenerating syncs project.yml; clean build refreshes stale signatures. Incremental builds can leave dylib/test bundle signatures out of sync.
    44→
    45→## AppKit Gotchas
    46→
    47→- **Cmd-shortcuts vs keyDown** — `performKeyEquivalent` fires before `keyDown`. Cmd-modified → menu items; bare keys → `ImageScrollView.keyDown`.
    48→- **Never put `keyDown` on NSViewController when NSScrollView is first responder.** NSScrollView intercepts arrow/Space/PageUp/PageDown. Override on NSScrollView subclass.
    49→- **`NSMenuItemValidation`** — protocol conformance, not `override`.
    50→- **Overlay event passthrough** — display-only overlays override `hitTest` → `nil`. For drag-drop, child `NSImageView` must call `unregisterDraggedTypes()` to prevent intercepting parent's drag session.
    51→- **NSVisualEffectView + alpha animation** — animating `alphaValue` causes material compositing flash. Use plain `layer.backgroundColor` with semi-transparent color instead.
    52→- **NSCollectionView re-enables scrollers** during layout/reloadData. Override getter+setter in subclass to lock off; simple property assignment is insufficient.
    53→- **NSCollectionView `didSelectItemsAt` fires on arrow keys** — filter with `NSApp.currentEvent?.type == .leftMouseUp` for click-only. Arrow key selection does NOT auto-scroll; call `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` manually in the else branch.
    54→- **NSCollectionView `scrollToItems` unreliable** — use `layoutAttributesForItem(at:)?.frame` + `scrollToVisible(_:)` instead for reliable programmatic scrolling.
    55→- **NSCollectionView internal auto-scroll during selection** — `NSCollectionView` calls `scrollToItems` internally after selection changes (arrow keys). Suppress by overriding `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` in a subclass with a `suppressAutoScroll` flag; set the flag around your own scroll calls so only your animation runs.
    56→- **NSCollectionView scrollbar + `availableLayoutWidth`** — When using a legacy always-visible scrollbar (`VisibleScroller` subclass), use `contentView.bounds.width` for `availableLayoutWidth`, not `bounds.width`, to account for the scroller's width.
    57→- **CALayer border clipping in NSCollectionView cells** — `borderWidth` draws half inside, half outside bounds. With `masksToBounds = true` + adjacent cell overlap, borders get clipped. Fix: inset highlightLayer frame by `borderWidth/2` so border is fully inside bounds; set `zPosition` high to render above subview layers.
    58→- **`NSCollectionViewPrefetching` doesn't exist in AppKit** — UIKit-only.
    59→- **`setMagnification` synchronously triggers `reflectScrolledClipView`** — Any state that must be set before the scroll/magnify callback (e.g., zoom suppression flags) must be set BEFORE calling `setMagnification`, not after. The delegate callback (`scrollViewMagnificationDidChange`) fires even later.
    60→
    61→## XCUITest Gotchas
    62→
    63→- **NSScrollView accessibility** — only `setAccessibilityIdentifier`; never override `.scrollArea` role.
    64→- **Bare key events unreliable.** Use Cmd-modified menu shortcuts.
    65→- **Always assert `XCTWaiter` result** — `.wait(...)` returns `.timedOut` silently.
    66→
    67→## Centering & Zoom
    68→
    69→- **Never sync fullscreen with fixed delays.** Use `didEnterFullScreen`/`didExitFullScreen` notifications.
    70→- **Centering math: one coordinate space.** Never divide `statusBarH` by magnification.
    71→- **Anchor out-of-bounds** — When anchor lies outside document bounds, use document center. Clamping causes rightward bias.
    72→- **`isZooming` flag** suppresses force-recenter during zoom to preserve pan position.
    73→- **resizeToFitImage below min** — When target < window minimum, early return to avoid drift.
    74→
    75→## Scroll & Page-Turn
    76→
    77→- **Trackpad vs mouse wheel** — Detect via `event.phase != [] || event.momentumPhase != []`. Thresholds: trackpad 80–250pt, wheel 10–40pt (3-tier sensitivity).
    78→- **Trackpad page-turn: edge-start + accumulate + once-per-gesture.** Momentum lock 0.6s after turn. `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` flag blocks the entire old scroll sequence until a fresh `phase=.began && momentumPhase=[]` gesture.
    79→- **Momentum must not accumulate for page-turn** — Momentum delta is massive; if accumulated, all sensitivity levels feel identical. Exclude via early `return` inside `if isTrackpad`, NOT via `if isTrackpad && !isMomentumEvent` — the latter causes momentum to fall into the `else` mouse-wheel branch which lacks `gestureBeganAtEdge` protection, breaking the "extra swipe at edge" requirement.
    80→- **NSScrollView fallback deceleration** — If momentum events are blocked without calling `super.scrollWheel`, NSScrollView detects disrupted momentum tracking and launches its own fallback deceleration animation after `momentumPhase=.ended`, directly manipulating clipView and bypassing `scrollWheel` override entirely. Fix: still call `super.scrollWheel` for momentum events; suppress visual movement by overriding `reflectScrolledClipView` to clamp position to top/bottom. Use `isEnforcingScrollPosition` guard to prevent recursion. **Critical**: do NOT add an `isInScrollWheelHandler` guard to `reflectScrolledClipView` — CoreAnimation-driven fallback updates happen outside `scrollWheel`, so the guard would let them bypass the clamp and cause half-page drift. Instead, rely on clearing `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` on `momentumPhase=.ended` to re-enable arrow keys/programmatic scroll after momentum finishes.
    81→- **`isAtTop`/`isAtBottom` must use `yScrollBounds(contentInsets)`** — comparing directly against `docFrame.height` ignores `contentInsets` and causes premature page-turn trigger when status bar padding is non-zero. Always derive top/bottom thresholds via `yScrollBounds` for consistency with `reflectScrolledClipView` clamp logic.
    82→- **Keyboard nav** — Arrow left/right and up/down are separate toggles. 3 extra presses at edge for arrows; 1 for PageUp/PageDown/Space.
    83→
    84→## GPU Rendering
    85→
    86→- **`ImageContentView` uses `layer.contents = cgImage`**, not `draw()`. GPU affine transform for zoom.
    87→- **`wantsUpdateLayer = true`** — never mix with `draw()`.
    88→- **Error placeholder** must be added to `self.view`, NOT `scrollView` — clipView covers subviews.
    89→
    90→## Dual Page View
    91→
    92→- **`DualPageContentView`** is permanent documentView. Use `currentDocumentSize` for fitting, not `contentView.image?.size`.
    93→- **`contentView` is computed** — `dualPageView.leadingPage`.
    94→- **All loading goes through `loadSpread`** — single mode wraps as `.single`.
    95→- **`imageSizeCache`** — index-based. Unknown sizes default to portrait. Clear on folder change.
    96→
    97→## Drag-Drop
    98→
    99→- **`folder` is optional** (~17 guard-let sites). Empty state: `EmptyStateView` overlay with drag support.
   100→- **Folder drops** — Use `ImageFolder(folderURL:)` (not `appendingPathComponent(".")` — breaks `deletingLastPathComponent()`).
   101→- **Subfolder discovery** — `init(folderURL:)` auto-searches up to 2 levels (BFS) when top-level has no images.
   102→
   103→## Fast Browse
   104→
   105→- **`ImageLoader.loadThumbnail`** returns `(image, fullSize)` tuple. `ThumbnailCacheKey(url, maxSize)` composite key isolates grid vs main view caches. `priority` parameter (default `.userInitiated`) allows `.utility` for buffer cells.    107→- **Thumbnail fallback is opt-in** — `settings.thumbnailFallback` (default off).
   108→- **`applyInitialScrollPosition`** must run after `applyCenteringInsetsIfNeeded`. For `.bottom`, defer one frame.

   111→## Quick Grid
   112→
   113→- **`QuickGridView`** — NSCollectionView overlay (G key toggle). Grid-local thumbnail cache separate from `ImageLoader.thumbnailCache`.
   114→- **Grid cell resize** — Pinch, Cmd+Scroll, Cmd+=+-, slider. All route through `applyItemSize()` → `invalidateLayout()` (never `reloadData()`). Four thumbnail tiers: ≤tier0→adaptive (quantized 20px steps), ≤tier1→240px, ≤tier2→480px, >tier2→720px; tier change clears thumbnails + reloads.

   116→- **Space-around layout** — `max(0, remaining)` + `floor(gap)` guards: negative remaining crashes FlowLayout; unrounded gaps cause line wrapping. Width-cache skips height-only recalcs.
   117→- **Grid persists across folder changes** — `clearCache()` + `configure()` instead of dismiss.
   118→- **Grid performance (Phase 1)** — `ThumbnailThrottle` actor limits concurrent decodes to 4. Scroll handler (20Hz) cancels non-visible tasks + evicts cache outside visible ± 50 buffer. Visible cells use `.userInitiated`, buffer cells `.utility`. Memory capped at 5% system RAM.

1→# Cee — CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→macOS image viewer (AppKit, Swift 6.2, arm64, Xcode 26).
     4→Replaces XEE. Core flow: Finder right-click → Open With → folder browse → pinch zoom.
     5→
     6→## Build & Test
     7→
     8→```bash
     9→xcodegen generate          # regenerate .xcodeproj after project.yml changes
    10→xcodebuild -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -configuration Debug build
    11→xcodebuild test -project Cee.xcodeproj -scheme Cee -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:CeeTests
    12→./scripts/test-e2e.sh      # XCUITest suite
    13→```
    14→
    15→Debug: `CEE_DEBUG_CENTERING=1` env var or `--debug-centering` flag.
    16→
    17→## Key Conventions
    18→
    19→- **No XIB/Storyboard** — all UI is programmatic.
    20→- **Entry point** — `main.swift` (not `@main`/`@NSApplicationMain`).
    21→- **Multi-instance window support** — `ImageWindowController.windows` (array) replaces the old `shared` singleton. `reuseWindow` setting (default `true`) controls whether new files open in the same window or a new one.
    22→- **project.yml** — source of truth for Xcode project. `.xcodeproj` is gitignored.
    23→- **Test targets** — `CeeTests` (unit) and `CeeUITests` (E2E). `TestHelpers.swift` provides shared `minimalPNG()`, `createJPEG(width:height:)`, `createPNG(width:height:)`.
    24→- **URL comparison gotcha** — `URL ==` can fail between manually constructed URLs and URLs from `contentsOfDirectory`. Use `.path` comparison.
    25→
    26→## Swift 6 Gotchas
    27→
    28→- **`ImageLoader` is an `actor`** — never pass `ImageFolder` (non-Sendable) across actor boundaries. Use `ImageItem` (Sendable).
    29→- **`setMagnification(_:centeredAt:)`** — parameter label is `centeredAt:`, not `centeredAtPoint:`.
    30→- **Protocol + @MainActor** — delegate protocols called from NSScrollView subclasses must be marked `@MainActor`.
    31→- **NSScrollView unflipped coordinates** — visual top = high Y, visual bottom = low Y.
    32→- **NSScrollView `contentInsets` visual semantics** — `.top` = visual top (high Y), `.bottom` = visual bottom (low Y). In `scrollRange`: `minY = -insets.bottom`, `maxY = docH - clipH + insets.top`.
    33→- **CALayer y-axis flipped in layer-backed NSView** — `wantsLayer = true` → `y=0` is visual top. Opposite of raw Core Animation.
    34→- **`deinit` cannot access stored properties** in strict concurrency. Use notification-based cleanup.
    35→- **CGImageSource pixel dimensions ignore EXIF orientation** — `kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth/Height` report raw sensor dimensions. For orientation 5-8, swap w/h. Thumbnails with `kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true` are auto-rotated, but `fullSize` is not.
    36→- **`@objc func` + default parameter + menu action** — `@objc func foo(amount: Int = 1)` gets ObjC selector `fooWithAmount:`. AppKit passes `NSMenuItem` pointer as the argument → huge `Int`. Fix: separate `@objc` action from internal impl.
    37→
    38→## XcodeGen Gotchas
    39→
    40→- **Unit test bundle type is `bundle.unit-test`**, not `bundle.unit-testing`. UI test is `bundle.ui-testing`.
    41→- **`GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES`** required for test targets without custom Info.plist.
    42→- **Xcode 26 debug dylib** — `ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB` splits app into stub + `Cee.debug.dylib`. Requires `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: YES` with ad-hoc signing, otherwise dylib fails system policy.
    43→- **Signing / test failures** — If CodeSign fails ("code object is not signed at all" in test bundle, or dylib system policy) or tests fail to run: run `xcodegen generate` then `xcodebuild clean build`. Regenerating syncs project.yml; clean build refreshes stale signatures. Incremental builds can leave dylib/test bundle signatures out of sync.
    44→
    45→## AppKit Gotchas
    46→
    47→- **Cmd-shortcuts vs keyDown** — `performKeyEquivalent` fires before `keyDown`. Cmd-modified → menu items; bare keys → `ImageScrollView.keyDown`.
    48→- **Never put `keyDown` on NSViewController when NSScrollView is first responder.** NSScrollView intercepts arrow/Space/PageUp/PageDown. Override on NSScrollView subclass.
    49→- **`NSMenuItemValidation`** — protocol conformance, not `override`.
    50→- **Overlay event passthrough** — display-only overlays override `hitTest` → `nil`. For drag-drop, child `NSImageView` must call `unregisterDraggedTypes()` to prevent intercepting parent's drag session.
    51→- **NSVisualEffectView + alpha animation** — animating `alphaValue` causes material compositing flash. Use plain `layer.backgroundColor` with semi-transparent color instead.
    52→- **NSCollectionView re-enables scrollers** during layout/reloadData. Override getter+setter in subclass to lock off; simple property assignment is insufficient.
    53→- **NSCollectionView `didSelectItemsAt` fires on arrow keys** — filter with `NSApp.currentEvent?.type == .leftMouseUp` for click-only. Arrow key selection does NOT auto-scroll; call `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` manually in the else branch.
    54→- **NSCollectionView `scrollToItems` unreliable** — use `layoutAttributesForItem(at:)?.frame` + `scrollToVisible(_:)` instead for reliable programmatic scrolling.
    55→- **NSCollectionView internal auto-scroll during selection** — `NSCollectionView` calls `scrollToItems` internally after selection changes (arrow keys). Suppress by overriding `scrollToItems(at:scrollPosition:)` in a subclass with a `suppressAutoScroll` flag; set the flag around your own scroll calls so only your animation runs.
    56→- **NSCollectionView scrollbar + `availableLayoutWidth`** — When using a legacy always-visible scrollbar (`VisibleScroller` subclass), use `contentView.bounds.width` for `availableLayoutWidth`, not `bounds.width`, to account for the scroller's width.
    57→- **CALayer border clipping in NSCollectionView cells** — `borderWidth` draws half inside, half outside bounds. With `masksToBounds = true` + adjacent cell overlap, borders get clipped. Fix: inset highlightLayer frame by `borderWidth/2` so border is fully inside bounds; set `zPosition` high to render above subview layers.
    58→- **`NSCollectionViewPrefetching` doesn't exist in AppKit** — UIKit-only.
    59→- **`setMagnification` synchronously triggers `reflectScrolledClipView`** — Any state that must be set before the scroll/magnify callback (e.g., zoom suppression flags) must be set BEFORE calling `setMagnification`, not after. The delegate callback (`scrollViewMagnificationDidChange`) fires even later.
    60→
    61→## XCUITest Gotchas
    62→
    63→- **NSScrollView accessibility** — only `setAccessibilityIdentifier`; never override `.scrollArea` role.
    64→- **Bare key events unreliable.** Use Cmd-modified menu shortcuts.
    65→- **Always assert `XCTWaiter` result** — `.wait(...)` returns `.timedOut` silently.
    66→
    67→## Centering & Zoom
    68→
    69→- **Never sync fullscreen with fixed delays.** Use `didEnterFullScreen`/`didExitFullScreen` notifications.
    70→- **Centering math: one coordinate space.** Never divide `statusBarH` by magnification.
    71→- **Anchor out-of-bounds** — When anchor lies outside document bounds, use document center. Clamping causes rightward bias.
    72→- **`isZooming` flag** suppresses force-recenter during zoom to preserve pan position.
    73→- **resizeToFitImage below min** — When target < window minimum, early return to avoid drift.
    74→
    75→## Scroll & Page-Turn
    76→
    77→- **Trackpad vs mouse wheel** — Detect via `event.phase != [] || event.momentumPhase != []`. Thresholds: trackpad 80–250pt, wheel 10–40pt (3-tier sensitivity).
    78→- **Trackpad page-turn: edge-start + accumulate + once-per-gesture.** Momentum lock 0.6s after turn. `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` flag blocks the entire old scroll sequence until a fresh `phase=.began && momentumPhase=[]` gesture.
    79→- **Momentum must not accumulate for page-turn** — Momentum delta is massive; if accumulated, all sensitivity levels feel identical. Exclude via early `return` inside `if isTrackpad`, NOT via `if isTrackpad && !isMomentumEvent` — the latter causes momentum to fall into the `else` mouse-wheel branch which lacks `gestureBeganAtEdge` protection, breaking the "extra swipe at edge" requirement.
    80→- **NSScrollView fallback deceleration** — If momentum events are blocked without calling `super.scrollWheel`, NSScrollView detects disrupted momentum tracking and launches its own fallback deceleration animation after `momentumPhase=.ended`, directly manipulating clipView and bypassing `scrollWheel` override entirely. Fix: still call `super.scrollWheel` for momentum events; suppress visual movement by overriding `reflectScrolledClipView` to clamp position to top/bottom. Use `isEnforcingScrollPosition` guard to prevent recursion. **Critical**: do NOT add an `isInScrollWheelHandler` guard to `reflectScrolledClipView` — CoreAnimation-driven fallback updates happen outside `scrollWheel`, so the guard would let them bypass the clamp and cause half-page drift. Instead, rely on clearing `suppressScrollSequenceAfterPageTurn` on `momentumPhase=.ended` to re-enable arrow keys/programmatic scroll after momentum finishes.
    81→- **`isAtTop`/`isAtBottom` must use `yScrollBounds(contentInsets)`** — comparing directly against `docFrame.height` ignores `contentInsets` and causes premature page-turn trigger when status bar padding is non-zero. Always derive top/bottom thresholds via `yScrollBounds` for consistency with `reflectScrolledClipView` clamp logic.
    82→- **Keyboard nav** — Arrow left/right and up/down are separate toggles. 3 extra presses at edge for arrows; 1 for PageUp/PageDown/Space.
    83→
    84→## GPU Rendering
    85→
    86→- **`ImageContentView` uses `layer.contents = cgImage`**, not `draw()`. GPU affine transform for zoom.
    87→- **`wantsUpdateLayer = true`** — never mix with `draw()`.
    88→- **Error placeholder** must be added to `self.view`, NOT `scrollView` — clipView covers subviews.
    89→
    90→## Dual Page View
    91→
    92→- **`DualPageContentView`** is permanent documentView. Use `currentDocumentSize` for fitting, not `contentView.image?.size`.
    93→- **`contentView` is computed** — `dualPageView.leadingPage`.
    94→- **All loading goes through `loadSpread`** — single mode wraps as `.single`.
    95→- **`imageSizeCache`** — index-based. Unknown sizes default to portrait. Clear on folder change.
    96→
    97→## Drag-Drop
    98→
    99→- **`folder` is optional** (~17 guard-let sites). Empty state: `EmptyStateView` overlay with drag support.
   100→- **Folder drops** — Use `ImageFolder(folderURL:)` (not `appendingPathComponent(".")` — breaks `deletingLastPathComponent()`).
   101→- **Subfolder discovery** — `init(folderURL:)` auto-searches up to 2 levels (BFS) when top-level has no images.

   103→## Fast Browse
   104→

   111→## Quick Grid
   112→

   114→- **Grid cell resize** — Pinch, Cmd+Scroll, Cmd+=+-, slider. All route through `applyItemSize()` → `invalidateLayout()` (never `reloadData()`). Four thumbnail tiers: ≤tier0→adaptive (quantized 20px steps), ≤tier1→240px, ≤tier2→480px, >tier2→720px; tier change clears thumbnails + reloads.

   117→- **Grid persists across folder changes** — `clearCache()` + `configure()` instead of dismiss.
